symptom: After mx convert to Mendix 11.17.0, re-applying an idempotent `create or modify page` reported 'Replaced page' on every run. mx check stayed clean. The rewrite dropped three properties 11.17 adds: Forms$Page.PopupOnCloseAction (a Forms$CancelChangesClientAction), Forms$Page.UseOldPopupCloseAction, and CustomWidgets$CustomWidget.SystemTextOverrides (an empty list).
cause: canon.CompletePropertySets fills only the keys the measured table lists, and the table had no 11.17.0 rows. A new key on an element mxcli writes is absent from every write until someone measures that version.
fix: Ran the doctype gate against mx 11.17.0 (MX_BINARY=…/11.17.0/modeler/mx MXCLI_PROPERTY_SETS_RECORD=… go test -tags integration -run TestMxCheck_DoctypeScripts ./mdl/executor/; 81 scripts, mx check clean on all), then ran propdefaults, and kept only the three page and widget rows. The values match every page of a blank 11.17.0 project and the converted page. Because MDL cannot state the popup close behaviour, UpdatePage carries a stored page's PopupOnCloseAction and UseOldPopupCloseAction, so a page Studio Pro set to the old behaviour keeps it rather than taking the default.
insight: Re-run the gate once per new Mendix minor: it is the only thing that finds keys a version adds, and running it found more than the report did. 11.17 also restructures workflow boundary events (BoundaryEvents -> BoundaryEventContainers; NotifyNotificationBoundaryEventTarget.BoundaryEvent -> Activity). Those rows were deliberately NOT recorded: filling an empty BoundaryEventContainers next to a populated BoundaryEvents would misdescribe the document, so the writer has to change. A default fill is right for a NEW element and wrong for state a person set; a key MDL cannot state needs a carry on the update path as well as a row. Verified on 11.17.0: the converted repro writes nothing on either run, a damaged copy is repaired in one run, a stored UseOldPopupCloseAction true survives a real edit (and becomes false without the carry), and an 11.16.1 page is byte-identical.
test: mdl/backend/modelsdk/page_popup_close_2612_test.go (carry, pre-11.17 control, a value the rebuild states wins); modelsdk/canon tests over the table; live control: without the carry, a stored true is reset to false
